frozen_rule: W (roll12wide) replaces G (roll12cancel) as the arithmetic default if W has 0 wrong, W solved >= G solved - 2 (noise band), and W arm wall <= 0.95 x G arm wall (exact, from UTC timestamps).
disclosure: Weaknesses that remain in arms.py-driven arms (arms.py is pinned; disclose in reports): flush_caches ignores the ssh exit status and the HTTP status (only the response text is recorded), delta() accepts negative deltas after a counter reset, parse() counts a missing counter as 0 and accepts non-finite values, wait_idle() returns a busy snapshot after its limit without failing, and an energy failure does not change the exit code.
design_disclosure: Design notes: (1) G and W run the same agents with the same prompts and seeds (slots pair exactly); W only moves start times: once no case waits for admission, a case with at least one failed agent may start its next slots up to 8 in flight, oldest case first, least-loaded node first, keeping 2 permits per node free for judges; widened slots may run on another node than in G; (2) the trigger is slot occupancy and failure counts, never elapsed time and never task content; (3) the plan's code_sha256 pins are records checked by review, not enforced by the runner.
